name.en: Ritmo Cream Jersey Ruffled Maxi Dress with Ruffled Straps, a Soft Column and a Flounced Hem

description.en: A cream jersey maxi with ruffled straps and a flounce at the hem. The knit column skims instead of clinging.
description.pt-BR: Longo creme de jersey, alças de babado e folho na barra. A malha acompanha o corpo sem agarrar.
